study: Preregistered lower-rank Legendre CPU accuracy controls
scope: Four new CPU minimal Recurrence Galerkin T72 uniform trajectories. Fixed existing quadrature mapping, layers, lift, initial and boundary data. Three scoring grids, four physical norms against both qualified FD references, a per-cell conservative comparison with the established same-rate larger Legendre anchor, and sustained alternating full-horizon probes. Exact observed rank is recorded. No speed comparison and no reuse of prior candidates' qualification.
